title: SpatialEffect2（中文说明）
text: SpatialEffect2 用于估计空间干预下、按距离索引的 平均边际化效应（AME），适用于存在未知干扰（unknown interference）的设置。 主要功能： - 支持点干预与多边形干预 - 支持 edge / disk / donut 三种距离定义 - 支持随机化分位数区间（Per.CI） - 支持 Conley 空间 HAC 区间（Conley.CI） - 支持局部多项式平滑与偏差修正 教程已直接写到 pkgdown 首页： - pkgdown/index.md 在包根目录生成站点： 英文主文档： - README.md

text: 配套参数：
code: Ydata <- data.frame(   x = runif(200, 0, 100),   y = runif(200, 0, 100),   outcome = rnorm(200) ) ras = NULL, Ydata = Ydata, outcome = "outcome", x_coord_Y = "x", y_coord_Y = "y"

title: SpatialEffect2（中文说明）
text: Zdata：每行一个干预节点。 treatment：Zdata 中二元处理变量列名。 dVec：估计 AME 的距离网格。 此外： - 点干预必须给 x_coord_Z, y_coord_Z。 - 多边形干预给 ras_Z 即可（坐标自动推导）。

title: SpatialEffect2（中文说明）
text: ras：terra::SpatRaster 结果面；若为 NULL 则走 kriging。 Ydata, outcome, x_coord_Y, y_coord_Y：kriging 输入。 ras_Z：多边形干预（sf / SpatRaster / SpatVector）。

title: SpatialEffect2（中文说明）
text: "edge"：只看边界 "disk"：看累计 [0,d] "donut"：相邻累计环差分（常用） dist.metric："Euclidean" 或 "Geodesic"。 numpts, evalpts, .unique：圈层采样控制。

title: SpatialEffect2（中文说明）
text: covs：协变量矩阵（nz x p 或 nz*length(dVec) x p）。 prob_treatment：倾向得分列名（IPW）。 blockvar, clustvar：置换推断时分层/聚类变量。

title: SpatialEffect2（中文说明）
text: per.se：是否计算随机化区间 Per.CI。 conley.se：是否计算 Conley 区间 Conley.CI。 kernel："uni", "tri", "epa"。 cutoff：Conley 核带宽。 alpha：显著性水平。 edf：是否启用有效自由度调整。 nPerms：置换次数。

title: SpatialEffect2（中文说明）
text: smooth：是否平滑。 bw, bw_debias：平滑与偏差修正带宽（NULL 时自动 CV）。 bias_correction：是否偏差修正。 smooth.conley.se：是否计算平滑曲线标准误。 conf.band：是否计算平滑曲线统一置信带。

title: SpatialEffect2（中文说明）
text: m, lambda：kriging 参数。 n_threads：并行线程数。

title: SpatialEffect2（中文说明）
text: SpatialEffect(...) 返回 "SpatialEffect" 对象，常见元素： AME_est：data.frame，列为 d, taud_est Per.CI：length(dVec) x 2 Conley.SE：长度为 length(dVec) 的向量 Conley.CI：length(dVec) x 2 AME_est_smoothed：平滑结果（d, tau_smoothed） smoothed.Conley.CI / smoothed.Conley.CB Parameters：内部参数与中间量 SpatialEffectTest(...) 输出： - test.stat：给定区间 AME 求和统计量 - test.CI：sharp null 下置换区间

title: SpatialEffect2（中文说明）
text: 先做几何体检。 保证 CRS 一致。 保证干预和结果面的空间重叠。 先跑保守基线。 建议从 cType = "donut"、smooth = 0、per.se = 1、conley.se = 1 开始。 再加平滑。 先看未平滑结果稳定性，再启用 smooth = 1。 若自动带宽不稳，固定 bw / bw_debias。 面向政策区间做检验。 用 SpatialEffectTest(result, test.range = c(, b)) 直接评估关键距离段。 做稳健性检查。 对比 edge / disk / donut。 改 cutoff、kernel、dVec 步长，检查结论是否稳定。

title: SpatialEffect2（中文说明）
text: 检查 CRS。 检查空间重叠。 检查 Zdata 与干预几何行数和顺序。 对 donut 适当调大 dVec 步长。

title: Jayachandran et al. (2017)
text: example follows Jayachandran et al. (2017), randomized intervention Uganda forest conservation. Treatment assigned polygon units, outcomes come spatial forest-loss raster data. use setting estimate forest-loss effects vary distance intervention polygon. Download Jayachandran Data Bundle (.zip)

title: Jayachandran et al. (2017)
code: library(SpatialEffect2) library(terra) library(sf)  # The article ships with a small replication bundle so the code does not rely # on any local file paths. jay_bundle <- locate_bundle("jayachandran_etal_2017_bundle.zip") stopifnot(!is.na(jay_bundle))  td <- tempfile("jay2017_") dir.create(td) unzip(jay_bundle, exdir = td)  base_dir <- file.path(td, "jayachandran_etal_2017") tif_path <- file.path(base_dir, "data", "rct_uganda_gfc_updated.tif") shp_path <- file.path(base_dir, "data", "digitized_rct", "rct_studyarea_vectorized.shp")  ras_all <- rast(tif_path)  # Use the forest-loss layer and coarsen it slightly so the vignette runs fast. ras_loss <- if ("fcloss2012" %in% names(ras_all)) ras_all[["fcloss2012"]] else ras_all[[min(3, nlyr(ras_all))]] ras <- aggregate(ras_loss, fact = 20, fun = mean, na.rm = TRUE)  # Project to a meter-based CRS so distances in dVec are interpreted in meters. ras <- project(ras, "EPSG:32636")  map_sf <- st_read(shp_path, quiet = TRUE)  # SpatialEffect2 accepts polygon interventions through ras_Z. map_vect <- project(vect(map_sf), crs(ras))  # Keep one treatment row per intervention polygon. Zdata <- data.frame(treatment = as.integer(st_drop_geometry(map_sf)$z))

title: Jayachandran et al. (2017)
code: dVec_km <- seq(0, 15, by = 1)  # The raster is projected in meters, so convert the display grid from km to m. dVec_m <- dVec_km * 1000  # With cType = "donut", each point after 0 km uses the adjacent 1-km ring: # 1 km uses [0, 1] km, 2 km uses [1, 2] km, and so on.  result <- SpatialEffect(   ras = ras,   ras_Z = map_vect,   Zdata = Zdata,   treatment = "treatment",   dVec = dVec_m,   cType = "donut",   dist.metric = "Euclidean",   smooth = 0,    # Use Conley SE so the S3 plot can display uncertainty. For a fuller   # randomization analysis, increase nPerms and set per.se = 1.   per.se = 0,   conley.se = 1,   cutoff = 10000,   nPerms = 200,   n_threads = 1L )  head(result$AME_est, 8) #>      d     taud_est #> 1    0 -0.012591346 #> 2 1000 -0.008647901 #> 3 2000 -0.008371255 #> 4 3000 -0.006474221 #> 5 4000 -0.004568744 #> 6 5000 -0.002353318 #> 7 6000 -0.002724544 #> 8 7000 -0.001572861

code: graphics::plot(   result,   smooth = FALSE,   ci.type = "conley",   style = "lines",   xlab = "Distance from intervention polygon (meters)",   ylab = "Estimated AME",   main = "Estimated AME Curve" ) # The S3 summary method is convenient for a quick numeric check. summary(result, dVec.range = c(0, 5000)) #> Call: SpatialEffect #>  #>      dVec AME_est Conley.CI.l Conley.CI.u #> [1,]    0  -0.013      -0.031       0.006 #> [2,] 1000  -0.009      -0.025       0.008 #> [3,] 2000  -0.008      -0.022       0.005 #> [4,] 3000  -0.006      -0.020       0.007 #> [5,] 4000  -0.005      -0.016       0.007 #> [6,] 5000  -0.002      -0.011       0.006  ame <- result$AME_est ame$km <- ame$d / 1000 subset(ame, km %in% c(0, 1, 3, 5, 10, 15)) #>        d      taud_est km #> 1      0 -0.0125913461  0 #> 2   1000 -0.0086479013  1 #> 4   3000 -0.0064742213  3 #> 6   5000 -0.0023533184  5 #> 11 10000 -0.0003329416 10 #> 16 15000  0.0001494409 15

code: library(SpatialEffect2) library(terra) library(sf)  ferraro_bundle <- locate_bundle("ferraro_etal_2015_sf_bundle.zip") stopifnot(!is.na(ferraro_bundle))  td <- tempfile("ferraro2015_") dir.create(td) unzip(ferraro_bundle, exdir = td)  base_dir <- file.path(td, "ferraro_etal_2015_sf") pa_path <- file.path(base_dir, "data", "Costa Rica", "PAs_Reproj", "PAs_before80_1.shp") forest_path <- file.path(   base_dir,   "data", "Costa Rica", "Deforestation and Carbon", "Spatial",   "final_pixels_w_covs.shp" )  protected_areas <- st_read(pa_path, quiet = TRUE) forest <- st_read(forest_path, quiet = TRUE) forest <- st_transform(forest, st_crs(protected_areas)) protected_areas <- st_make_valid(protected_areas)

title: Ferraro et al. (2015)

code: # The helper prepares three objects used by SpatialEffect(): # ras: outcome raster; ras_Z_sf: intervention tiles; Zdata: treatment data. prepared <- prepare_ferraro_inputs(protected_areas, forest)  ras <- prepared$ras ras_Z_sf <- prepared$ras_Z_sf Zdata <- prepared$Zdata  c(   n_protected_areas = nrow(protected_areas),   n_outcome_parcels = nrow(forest),   n_nodes = nrow(Zdata),   n_treated = sum(Zdata$treatment == 1),   n_control = sum(Zdata$treatment == 0) ) #> n_protected_areas n_outcome_parcels           n_nodes         n_treated  #>                39             13100               770               225  #>         n_control  #>               545  prepared$boundary_counts #>  #>    0    1 <NA>  #>  545  225 3845

title: SpatialEffect2
text: SpatialEffect2 estimates distance-indexed Average Marginalized Effects (AME) spatial interventions unknown interference. tutorial uses small synthetic point-intervention example full workflow runs quickly: prepare outcome raster, define intervention nodes, estimate AME curve, add uncertainty, test distance range, plot result.

title: Estimate the Average Marginalized Effect (AME) Curve — SpatialEffect
text: ras SpatRaster outcome surface, NULL use kriging interpolation. Ydata Data frame outcome observations (used kriging outcome locations differ intervention nodes). outcome Character name outcome variable column. x_coord_Y, y_coord_Y Character names coordinate columns Ydata. ras_Z sf object polygon interventions, NULL point interventions. Can also SpatRaster SpatVector converted sf. Zdata Data frame intervention node attributes. x_coord_Z, y_coord_Z Character names coordinate columns Zdata (required point interventions). treatment Character name binary treatment column Zdata. covs Optional matrix covariates (nz rows nz*length(dVec) rows). prob_treatment Character name propensity score column Zdata IPW (observational studies). dVec Numeric vector distance values evaluate AME. dist.metric "Euclidean" (default) "Geodesic". cType Circle type: "edge" (default), "disk", "donut". numpts Number sampling points circle (auto-selected NULL). evalpts Multiplier auto-selected numpts (default 1). .unique Deduplicate raster cells per node (0 1). smooth Whether apply local polynomial smoothing (0 1). bw Bandwidth smoothing (auto-selected via CV NULL). bw_debias Bandwidth bias correction (auto-selected NULL). bias_correction Use bias-corrected smoothing (default TRUE). smooth.conley.se Compute Conley SE smoothed estimates (0 1). conf.band Compute uniform confidence bands smoothed AME (0 1). per.se Compute permutation-based CIs (0 1, default 1). blockvar Block variable stratified permutation. clustvar Cluster variable clustered permutation. conley.se Compute Conley spatial HAC SEs (0 1, default 1). kernel Kernel HAC: "uni"/"uniform", "tri"/"triangular", "epa"/"epanechnikov". cutoff Spatial bandwidth Conley SE (0 = EHW). alpha Significance level (default 0.05). edf Use effective degrees freedom adjustment (default FALSE). m Polynomial order kriging (default 2). lambda Smoothing parameter kriging (default 0.02). nPerms Number permutations (default 1000). n_threads Number threads parallel C++ computation (default 1). perm_engine Permutation generator randomization inference: "ri" (default, uses ri::genperms()), "auto" (use ri installed, otherwise fallback shuffle), "shuffle" (simple label reshuffling; ignores block/cluster design).

title: Estimate the Average Marginalized Effect (AME) Curve — SpatialEffect
text: S3 object class "SpatialEffect" containing: AME_est Data frame distance AME estimates Per.CI Permutation confidence intervals (per.se=1) Conley.SE Conley standard errors (conley.se=1) Conley.CI Conley confidence intervals (conley.se=1) AME_est_smoothed Smoothed estimates (smooth=1) smoothed.Conley.SE Smoothed Conley SEs (smooth=1 smooth.conley.se=1) smoothed.Conley.CI Smoothed Conley CIs smoothed.Conley.CB Uniform confidence bands (conf.band=1) Parameters List stored parameters downstream use

what: Decision 1: what is the outcome surface?
title: SpatialEffect2 Analysis Workflow — SpatialEffect2-workflow
text: Raster outcome Use ras outcome already gridded     surface, forest loss, pollution, temperature, population density.     direct workflow. Point outcome Use Ydata, outcome, x_coord_Y,     y_coord_Y outcomes point measurements. Set ras = NULL     SpatialEffect2 interpolates outcome surface. Check: outcome intervention objects use compatible coordinate reference systems. dist.metric = "Euclidean", distances interpreted units projected CRS.

what: Decision 2: what is the intervention geometry?
title: SpatialEffect2 Analysis Workflow — SpatialEffect2-workflow
text: Point interventions Use Zdata one row per node plus     coordinate columns supplied x_coord_Z y_coord_Z. Polygon interventions Pass polygons ras_Z. Keep one row     Zdata per polygon, order ras_Z. Coordinates     taken polygon centroids internally. Check: nrow(Zdata) must match number intervention nodes. polygons, row order matters.

what: Decision 3: which distance design answers the question?
title: SpatialEffect2 Analysis Workflow — SpatialEffect2-workflow
text: cType = "edge" Use outcome boundary exactly distance     d. closest asking, "happens right distance?" cType = "disk" Use cumulative region 0     d. useful total neighborhood effects radius. cType = "donut" Use adjacent rings. often easiest     interpret asking effects change move outward. Check: "donut", choose dVec step much smaller raster resolution. thin rings can create empty-ring NA values.

title: SpatialEffect2 Analysis Workflow — SpatialEffect2-workflow
text: Experimental study treatment probabilities known design     weighting needed, omit prob_treatment. Use blockvar     clustvar randomization blocked clustered. Observational study Estimate supply propensity score     Zdata, pass column name prob_treatment.     Inspect overlap interpreting weighted estimates. Check: propensity scores near 0 1 can dominate weighted estimates. Plot summarize propensity-score distribution.

what: Decision 5: how should uncertainty be shown?
title: SpatialEffect2 Analysis Workflow — SpatialEffect2-workflow
text: conley.se = 1 Adds spatial HAC standard errors     Conley.CI. Use cutoff kernel sensitivity     checks. per.se = 1 Adds permutation intervals Per.CI. Increase     nPerms final results. smooth = 1 Adds smoothed AME curve. Use     unsmoothed curve understandable. smooth.conley.se = 1 Adds uncertainty smoothed curve.     computationally demanding. Practical default: start smooth = 0, inspect raw AME curve, add smoothing sensitivity checks.
